note: Example compositions bundled by tools/music_authoring/library_player.py. Source song.json and matching preview/preview.json + preview/preview.wav live together under examples/music_authoring/. Paths resolve against the repository root. Catalog, sources and previews are trusted local inputs; the bundler embeds inert data and renders labels as text. Captured preview reports retain original run paths.

entries.name: Gatherer's Road — Overworld
entries.context: Brisk roaming theme; chord-tone bass under the minor-sixth motif and an E pickup into the opening. A minor, 136.36 BPM, 16 bars, 28.16 s per loop.

entries.name: Clash of Gatherers — Combat
entries.context: Driving battle theme; slower than the original rush, with fewer chromatic clashes and a final upbeat. D minor, 176.47 BPM, 16 bars, 21.76 s per loop.

entries.name: Hollow Depths — Cave Exploration
entries.context: Spacious cave theme; slower phrases and open harmony, with a quiet pickup instead of a terminal hold. A minor, 83.33 BPM, 12 bars, 34.56 s per loop.

entries.name: Gathered! — Victory
entries.context: Bright repeating victory fanfare; resolved upper harmony and a fifth leading into the tonic. C major, 187.50 BPM, 4 bars, 5.12 s per loop.

entries.name: Lost — Defeat
entries.context: Slow descending loss cue; consonant sustained notes and a quiet fifth leading back into the opening. A minor, 68.18 BPM, 4 bars, 14.08 s per loop.

entries.name: Showcase — Twilight (A minor)
entries.context: Four-channel demonstration; softened long seconds/sevenths against the bass. A minor, 125.00 BPM, 4 bars, 7.68 s per loop.

entries.name: Basic authoring example
entries.context: Two-bar teaching loop; stable thirds/fifths, a full-length bass and gentler percussion. C major, 125.00 BPM, 2 bars, 3.84 s per loop.

entries.name: Guide sketch — one-bar example
entries.context: One-bar teaching loop; lower supporting harmony replaces the doubled unison. C major, 100.00 BPM, 1 bar, 2.4 s per loop.

entries.name: First Light — Opening
entries.context: Title theme; a full opening melody, a lower reprise and cleaner chord transitions. E minor, 115.38 BPM, 24 bars, 49.92 s per loop.

entries.name: Hearth and Hollow — Village
entries.context: Gentle home-village tune; chord-aligned lead and a dominant turnaround into the opening. C major, 93.75 BPM, 8 bars, 20.48 s per loop.

entries.name: Greenwake Thicket — Forest
entries.context: Lively woodland call and response; smoother countervoice, reduced clashes and a lighter pulse tone. A Dorian, 130.43 BPM, 16 bars, 29.44 s per loop.

entries.name: Tideline Ramble — Coast
entries.context: Flowing shore melody; four accidental repeated-note interruptions joined into holds, smoother bass, quieter accompaniment and consistent short lead gaps. G major, 107.14 BPM, 12 bars, 26.88 s per loop.

entries.name: Marsh at Dusk — wetland gathering
entries.context: Rewritten eight-bar wetland melody in natural E minor; a clear question-and-answer phrase over Em–C–G–D / Em–Am–D–Em, held roots, quiet harmony and sparse mist noise. E minor, 78.95 BPM, 8 bars, 24.32 s per loop.

entries.name: Ancient Observatory — ruins boss gate
entries.context: Ruins theme; retained leading-tone tension, softer diminished passages and a lower upper register. B minor, 125.00 BPM, 24 bars, 46.08 s per loop.

entries.name: Pocket Nursery
entries.context: home village / creature nursery. D major, 88.24 BPM, 3/4, 16 bars, 32.64 s. 3/4 waltz, root–chord accompaniment, round pulse lead, quiet answering voice, restrained noise brushes.

entries.name: Cloverbound Route
entries.context: daytime meadow / gathering route. G major, 136.36 BPM, 4/4, 16 bars, 28.16 s. Dotted hook, eighth-note chord arpeggios, offbeat bass, narrow/round pulse contrast and backbeat noise.

entries.name: Lanternfen
entries.context: dusk wetland / rare creature habitat. E minor, 75.00 BPM, 4/4, 12 bars, 38.40 s. Spacious gates, alternating low/high-duty lead color, sparse lower-register echoes, held root bass and tiny noise rustles; raised seventh at dominant cadences.

entries.name: Bramble Skirmish
entries.context: wild creature encounter. D minor, 176.47 BPM, 4/4, 16 bars, 21.76 s. Fast gated riff, syncopated root/fifth bass, sixteenth-note broken chords, stepped duty accents and snare/noise fills; harmonic-minor dominant.

entries.name: Prism Burrow
entries.context: crystal cave / hidden nest exploration. F# minor, 100.00 BPM, 4/4, 16 bars, 38.40 s. Displaced quarter-note arpeggios, register-separated melody, quiet delayed answers, long bass pedals and sparse noise sparkles; E# is spelled F in the score.

entries.name: New Wings
entries.context: evolution grove / new companion celebration. A major, 150.00 BPM, 4/4, 12 bars, 19.20 s. Octave-lift fanfare, chord-tone countermelody, alternating pulse duty and volume accents, bright arpeggios, root/octave bass and rising noise fill.

entries.name: Snapdragon Sprint
entries.context: speedy dash / time-trial minigame. E major, 187.50 BPM, 4/4, 16 bars, 20.48 s. Engine arpeggio on the middle voice, staccato pulse lead, note-cut chatter accelerando into the loop, volume-slide swell with tremolo shimmer and a crisp noise backbeat.
